blocks.orig: Located on a gentle slope, Lake Eyasi Safari Lodge offers stunning views over the seasonal soda lake, all the way up to the Ngorongoro Conservation Area. All 16 tastefully furnished rooms are fitted with an ensuite bathroom and private terrace overlooking the lake. The decor blends elements from the surrounding landscape with modern solar-powered comfort. Key amenities include a swimming pool, a restaurant serving delicious continental cuisine, a bar/lounge, a gift shop, free Wi-Fi in public areas, and guided cultural tours to the Hadzabe and Datoga tribes.
blocks.html: From its spot on a gentle hillside, Lake Eyasi Safari Lodge looks out across the seasonal soda lake and on to the Ngorongoro Conservation Area. Its 16 rooms are tastefully furnished, and each one has a private terrace with lake views and its own bathroom. The interior mixes touches of the surrounding landscape with modern comforts powered by solar energy. Among the facilities are a pool, a bar/lounge, a gift shop, a restaurant with tasty continental dishes and free Wi-Fi in the shared spaces. The lodge also arranges guided cultural visits to the Datoga and Hadzabe tribes.
